name: Rebound Jab
description: Jab the striker's shoulder on the instant their own blow lands so the two forces meet.

name: Springback
description: Give ground with a blow and spring back in on its return to land a quick answer.

name: Returning Guard
description: Turn a strike aside with a guard that sends a small share of its force back down the arm.

name: Blow Count
description: Count the weight of each blow taken so the answer can match it.

name: Weighted Return
description: Catch a blow and hand back its force with a small weight added to the reply.

name: Rebounding Catch
description: Take a thrown missile into the guard and pass it back to the thrower at its own speed.

name: Recoil Wave
description: Release the force of several blows taken in one wave that strikes everyone near.

name: Returning Blow
description: Take a full blow and pass it back through the striker's own guard at the weight it came.

name: Sharpened Rebound
description: Turn the force of a heavy blow to a point and send it back through the striker's chest.

name: Ledger Glance
description: Glance down the field and read each figure's account of harms done and harms received.

name: Ledger Step
description: Step to the side where the account of blows is lightest and the user owes least.

name: Credit Glow
description: Draw on a stored credit of good deeds as a glow that steadies and strengthens the user.

name: Debit Sting
description: Debit a foe's qi with a sting sized to the harm they owe.

name: Sum Guard
description: Hold a guard whose strength rises with the sum of harms a foe has done.

name: Account Reading
description: Read a person's whole account at once and see which debts press on them hardest.

name: Debt Lock
description: Lock a foe's strongest technique behind the debt it has built and keep it shut.

name: Audit Beam
description: Fire a beam that strikes the point where the foe's debts press most and shows it to the user.

name: Open Account
description: Open the field as a ledger so that every foe's debts show and drag at their limbs.

name: Settlement Wave
description: Settle all the field's debts at once in a wave that strikes each foe by the harm they owe.

name: Exact Palm
description: Strike with an open palm weighed to the harm that was done and never more.

name: Even Poise
description: Hold the formal poise of a magistrate behind a guard that gives back what it takes.

name: Plumb Step
description: Step straight down the plumb line of the foe's balance and stop exactly at their reach.

name: Gauge Sense
description: Gauge the exact weight of the wrong a person has done by how they hold their shoulders.

name: Just Return
description: Return a blow in exactly its own measure through the guard that took it.

name: Level Scale
description: Level the scales on a foe so the stronger of two fighters is pressed down to the weaker.

name: Measured Verdict
description: Pronounce a blow of exact weight that strikes the foe and presses down their qi in equal measure.

name: Breaking Scale
description: Break the foe's balance of strength with a thrust that falls on the lighter side of their guard.

name: Deed Glimpse
description: Glimpse the shape of a foe's most recent deed in the way the qi clings to them.

name: Deed Ray
description: Loose a ray that carries the memory of the foe's last deed and stings by its weight.

name: Deed Guard
description: Turn aside a blow that repeats a deed the foe has done before.

name: Weight Step
description: Step with the whole weight of the user's good name behind the foot.

name: Deed Weight
description: Lay the weight of the foe's worst deed on their qi so that it drags at every move.

name: Deed Return
description: Return a deed to the doer by sending back the same sort of harm on the instant.

name: Seven Strikes
description: Throw seven quick strikes at once that answer seven earlier blows the foe has struck.

name: Deed Cascade
description: Let every deed of the foes in the field fall back on them at once as a cascade of force.

name: Deed Reckoning
description: Bind the foe to their own list of deeds and strike them with the weight of the worst.

name: Debt Oath
description: Speak a short oath to collect a debt and feel the qi rise to keep it.

name: Pledge Blow
description: Strike with the first blow of an oath and name the debt as it lands.

name: Debtor Guard
description: Hold a guard that stays firm until the debt it was pledged to is paid.

name: Debt Stride
description: Take a long stride toward the one who owes and close the gap before they can run.

name: Call Due
description: Call a debt due and press down the foe's qi until they answer it.

name: Bond Strike
description: Strike a bond into the foe's side that holds them to the debt they owe.

name: Debt Bond
description: Bind the debtor with a bond of owed harm that tightens each time they pull away.

name: Collection Rush
description: Rush the debtor in a single stride and collect the debt with a heavy blow.

name: Wound Memory
description: Feel the memory of an old wound in the qi of the one who dealt it.

name: Old Sting
description: Send an old hurt back as a bead of qi that stings where it was first laid.

name: Scar Shield
description: Harden the guard over old scars so that no blow finds them again.

name: Scar Pace
description: Step quickly away from the side where an old wound lies and leave it unguarded no more.

name: Echo Pang
description: Wake a pang of old guilt in the foe so that their thoughts turn inward for a breath.

name: Wound Return
description: Send an old wound's pain back along the line of the blow that reopened it.

name: Old Weight
description: Lay the weight of a long-past wrong on the foe's qi until it sinks.

name: Scar Pang
description: Pierce the foe at the place where they once wounded another.

name: Unforgotten Blow
description: Strike with the whole memory of the wrong so that the blow pierces and presses the foe's qi down.

name: Harm Remembered
description: Call back the harms done by all foes in the field and break their rhythm with the weight of them.
